---
title: "simstim agents install"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Install an agent on a host with its vendor's installer, in a session you can watch.

```text
simstim agents install <agent> [flags]
```

Runs the agent's official install command in a new session on the host, so you see its output and can answer its questions. Then it says how to log in: you run the agent's own login, in a session. simstim never logs in for you.

## Examples

```sh
simstim agents install claude --host my-vps
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--force` | run the installer even when the agent is installed, for example to update it |
| `--host <string>` | the host (needed when you have more than one) |

Part of [`agents`](agents.md): list the agents, and install one on a host.
